evidence.end_definition: value at measurement window end; separate final values are after drain
evidence.tail_slope_definition: OLS slope of exact-time-integrated B bin means over final configured fraction; descriptive trend, not a performance predictor.
evidence.queue_episode_definition: Warning requires both a configured absolute count and fraction of offered requests above the queue-wait threshold; it does not assert these observations are contiguous.
evidence.clock: same-run perf_counter_ns; no cross-clock timestamp subtraction
